{{Quote|There is no doubt that these Yuuzhan Vong have come to this galaxy with conquest on their agenda. The assaults on Dubrillion and Dantooine were not only relentless, but clearly designed as learning exercises.|[[Elegos A'Kla]]|<ref name="Onslaught">''[[The New Jedi Order: Dark Tide I: Onslaught]]''</ref>}}
'''Dubrillion''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Dubrillion system/Legends|Dubrillion system]] with beautiful [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]] and lush, green continents, a sky dotted with fluffy, white clouds. It was the sister-world of [[Destrillion]].<ref name="VP" />

Dubrillion was located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] near [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] and [[Muunilinst/Legends|Muunilinst]], in the heart of [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|CIS]] space during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="TEA" /> Dubrillion would duly become a world of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] after the Clone Wars; when that government fell, entrepreneur [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] would take-over the planet and serve as its [[Administrator/Legends|administrator]]. There was an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] [[Asteroid field/Legends|belt]] situated near the planet, which was used by Calrissian as the basis for a large [[Lando's Folly|operation]] some time after the Empire's end.<ref name="VP" /> In addition, Dubrillion hosted many hotels and apartments with luxury suites, located in its massive high-rise cities. [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] was its ambassador for a short time.<ref name="VP" /> During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], the planet was attacked, and eventually conquered, by the invading [[Yuuzhan Vong]].<ref name="Ruin" /> Following the Yuuzhan Vong's defeat, Dubrillion later became a world of the [[Fel Empire]].<ref name="TEA" />

==History==
===Old Republic era===
{{Quote|Our luck changed when Vaylin's fleet sacked Dubrillion. After that, there... wasn't much left to be king of anymore. He fled, along with his nobles.|[[Risha Drayen]]|<ref name="The Endless Abyss">{{TORcite|type=class|Smuggler|The Endless Abyss|the ''Long Shadow''}}</ref>}}
In the decades before the [[Great Galactic War]], the planet was ruled by the [[Drayen dynasty|Drayen]] family, a dynasty of war heroes who took their position as Dubrillion's rulers through treachery. Their reign lasted until [[King/Legends|King]] [[Arak Drayen III]] was overthrown by the [[Noble/Legends|nobility]] of the planet. However, although the Drayens managed to keep the crown out of their usurpers' hands, the family went into exile, as they were being hounded and pursued. It wasn't until the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] that a smuggler known as the [[Voidhound]], under the direction of the pirate lord [[Nok Drayen]] and his daughter [[Risha Drayen|Risha]], located the crown. Risha then set-off on the mission of reclaiming the throne of Dubrillion, intending to do so honorably. She managed to find a sympathetic count amongst Dubrillion's aristocracy, but this soon sparked a civil war dividing the aristocracy, between supporting Risha and the then-current king, [[Actavarus III]].<ref name="The Endless Abyss" /> During that same time, the planet was afflicted by a famine and was forced to purchase [[Foodstuff/Legends|foodstuffs]] for the starving masses.<ref name="Feeding the People">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Underworld Trading|Feeding the People}}</ref> Dubrillion was eventually [[Sacking of Dubrillion|sacked]] by [[Empress/Legends|Empress]] [[Vaylin]]'s [[Eternal Fleet]] during the [[War against Zakuul|revolt]] against the [[Eternal Empire]]. The planet was devastated, forcing the King to flee the planet with his nobles.<ref name="KotET">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=class|Smuggler|Unhappy Returns|Nar Shaddaa}}</ref>

===Clone Wars===
With the onset of the Clone Wars, Dubrillion was located within [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] space, though its [[Myto sector/Legends|resident sector of space]] was contested between both the CIS and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="TEA" /> Following the deaths of the [[Separatist Council/Legends|Separatist Council]] members on [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]], and the end of the war, the planet fell to the rule of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="TEA" />

===Galactic Civil War===
{{Quote|Great work, Rogues! We're taking less hits from that superlaser now. We move into a safer position&hellip; But we're still pinned down by that superlaser. We can't hit its vital areas from the air.|[[Crix Madine/Legends|Crix Madine]]|<ref name="RS3" />}}
[[File:Dubrillion.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The superlaser facility during the Battle of Dubrillion in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].]]
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the Dubrillion system was located in [[Oversector Outer]], formerly known as the Greater Seswenna.<ref name="TEA" /> The world hosted a factory and testing facility for new weapons in the midst of the [[Dubrillion Ocean]], including a prototype laser for the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]]. [[Battle of Dubrillion (Galactic Civil War)|It was destroyed]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]] by [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]], with the help of defected [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Crix Madine/Legends|Crix Madine]], after several [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] ships passing the planet were destroyed by a beam fired from Dubrillion. The superlaser facility was subsequently rendered inoperable by the Rebel forces.<ref name="RS3" />

Following the fall of the Empire at the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of]] [[Endor/Legends|Endor]], the area of Oversector Outer that Dubrillion was located in was reformed by [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Ardus Kaine]] into the [[Pentastar Alignment]], and Dubrillion became one of its member worlds.<ref name="TEA" />

===Yuuzhan Vong War===
{{Quote|I have come to correct a problem we've had sharing information with you. Something very important has happened, something that could determine the future of both the New Republic and the Remnant.''"<br />"''You're referring to the fall of Dubrillion.''"<br />"''How did you know?''"<br />"''Dubrillion and other New Republic worlds that border our space are of interest to us. I'm certain. Consul, it will come as no surprise that we had agents on Dubrillion. While the messages they got out did not contain a lot of information, we knew something was amiss. The cessation of their communications confirmed it was a serious problem.|[[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] and [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]]|<ref name="Ruin" />}}
During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]] in [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], Dubrillion, now under the flag of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], was the site of [[Lando's Folly]], an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] assault course that contestants ran using [[TIE Advanced x1/Legends|TIE Advanced x1]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]]. [[Pilot/Legends|Pilots]] such as [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] soon attained high status on the challenge's leaderboards.<ref name="VP" />

[[File:Warship_dto.jpg|thumb|right|250px|[[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] engage the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] at Dubrillion in [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]].]]
Dubrillion was also one of the first New Republic worlds to fall to the [[Extragalactic/Legends|extra-galactic]] Yuuzhan Vong. Despite an [[Battle of Dubrillion|initial assault]] on Dubrillion failing against New Republic defenses,<ref name="VP" /> the Yuuzhan Vong set-up a base camp in the nearby asteroid field and, for two [[Standard month/Legends|months]], attacked ships traveling-to and -from Dubrillion, and sent [[Yorik-et|coralskipper]] squadrons to wreak havoc on the planet's surface, slowly wearing down Administrator Calrissian's defenses. When the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] arrived to help evacuate the planet, the Yuuzhan Vong [[Evacuation of Dubrillion|emerged]] from the asteroid field, destroying countless ships carrying refugees and invading Dubrillion all at once.

After the New Republic forces had retreated to [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]], the Yuuzhan Vong concentrated on subjugating the remaining populace of Dubrillion. Despite earlier ferocity shown by the coralskipper attacks, most of Dubrillion's surface was left in a recognizable state. [[Shedao Shai]] oversaw the conquest of Dubrillion, and chose the planet as the main base for the Yuuzhan Vong in the Outer Rim. The remaining citizens that had been unable to flee attempted to resist the invasion, but were eventually found and [[Death/Legends|killed]] by [[Chazrach]] warriors sent in by Shai to rout resistance holdouts. Others were enslaved to help future [[Terraforming/Legends|terraforming]] projects on the planet.<ref name="Ruin" /> A major landmark, the [[Dubrillion Aquarium]], was left intact by the invaders&mdash;a rare mercy, owing to its vast collection of galactic marine specimens, which appealed to the Yuuzhan Vong's reverence of natural life.<ref name="Ruin" />

In the later stages of the Yuuzhan Vong War, Dubrillion, as purported to [[Supreme Overlord]] [[Shimrra Jamaane]] by prominent Yuuzhan Vong [[Priest caste|priests]], was a site affected by a particularly powerful uprising of the [[Jeedai heresy|''Jeedai'' heresy]] that would help unseat the Vong [[Yuuzhan Vong empire|hold on the galaxy]].<ref name="DW">''[[The New Jedi Order: Destiny's Way]]''</ref>

Yuuzhan Vong forces from Dubrillion under the leadership of [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[B'shith Vorrik]] later attacked the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] in [[29 ABY/Legends|29 ABY]]; these forces launched an [[Battle of Bastion|attack]] on [[Bastion/Legends|Bastion]] and [[Battle of Bescane|another]] at [[Bescane/Legends|Bescane]].<ref name="TEA" />

===Later history===
In [[137 ABY]], Dubrillion was located in a region under the control of the [[Fel Empire]], and remained loyal to the subsequent [[Empire-in-exile]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Dubrillion, along with its sister world Destrillion, was first introduced in [[1999]] in ''[[The New Jedi Order: Vector Prime]]'' by [[R. A. Salvatore]], the first novel in the [[Star Wars: The New Jedi Order|''New Jedi Order'']] series of novels. The world also made appearances&mdash;and was given brief mentions&mdash;in several subsequent novels in that series, and later appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron III: Rebel Strike]]'' in [[2003]]. Much of Dubrillion's general allegiances and placement in galactic history was provided by ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' in [[2009]].
